cue: Code that deploys must reach the branch it deploys from before the decision to go live.
lesson: Ship it switched off by a committed switch, tested to read no secret and touch nothing while off; the go-live is the one commit that switches it on, and it can be reviewed and undone like any other.
evidence: aip-59ad: theOS/release/deploy.on read off through #1783 and #1784 (run 41315961980 checked it and skipped every deploy step); Gate B was #1786, which set it on (run 41316332593 deployed).
